tellings.quote: And I wrote a short story about this about Bon Norman's death called the open doors

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author known for writing about his own encounters with strange beings, says on a podcast that he wrote a short story called "The Open Doors" about the death of John von Neumann, a leading mathematician and scientist, in 1957. Strieber ties the story to a fear von Neumann is said to have held at the end of his life, which he links to the idea that some lines of physics research were deliberately sent down a dead end.
